primary_gt.computed_interpretation: The compound label wins by 5 points because the ledger has two burn gates, one heterogeneity gate, one dry-windy gate, two smoke-text gates, and one population gate; the burn-only label lacks the uniform-burn and high-annual-change gates.

criteria.name: final label and margin
criteria.description: Returns answer compound_smoke_burn_exposure, score_margin 5, and the three scores 7, 2, and 1.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for the correct label with an incomplete or slightly wrong margin; award 1 point for recognizing the compound label without a valid score comparison.

criteria.name: event-window and weather metrics
criteria.description: Computes 182 event days, 46 weather-overlap days, 9 dry/windy days, and dry/windy share about 0.195652.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for two or three correct values, or for correct counts with a rounded share within 0.01.

criteria.name: burn and landscape-change metrics
criteria.description: Reports dNBR mean about 0.155941, minimum about -1.074075, maximum about 0.9738, standard deviation about 0.109541, and annual embedding-change mean about 0.028207.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points if most values are correct but one statistic is omitted; award 1 point if only the mean or maximum is correct.

criteria.name: text and population flags
criteria.description: Reports rounded population about 362810 and sets both smoke-transport and air-quality flags to true.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct population with one missing text flag, or correct text flags with a population value within 1000.

criteria.name: gate and formula arithmetic
criteria.description: Applies all nine gates with values 1,1,1,1,1,1,1,0,0 and uses the stated formulas to obtain scores 7,2,1.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for one or two gate errors that do not change the final label; award 1 point for using the formulas but omitting several gates.

criteria.name: compact JSON and computed interpretation
criteria.description: Returns exactly the requested fields and gives a concise interpretation tied to the score ledger.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for valid JSON with extra or missing fields, or for an interpretation that is present but not tied to the computed scores.
